photos.desc: Cascuda , Blattella germanica, en Santiago de Compostela
A german cockroach who recently underwent ecdysis. It is now teneral until its cuticle hardens within the next two hours during which it will grow in size and darken in color or "tan".

Illustration from Conrad Quensel's Svensk Zoologi. Första bandet. . Published in Stockholm 1806. Blatta orientalis, male Blatta orientalis, female Female larvae of blatta orientalis Blatta orientalis,
